summary.name: Vivaldi Browser
summary.one_liner: Vivaldi is a privacy-focused, highly customizable web browser from an independent European company, with built-in email, calendar, feed reader, and productivity tools.
use_cases: combining multiple email accounts in one inbox
summary.what_it_does: Vivaldi is a web browser that bundles many features built in, including an email client, calendar, feed reader, notes in the sidebar, and web panels. Tabs can be grouped into two-level tab stacks, organized into workspaces, or shown side by side with tab tiling. Users can add mouse gestures and command chains for custom shortcuts and workflows. Built-in ad and tracker blockers are included, and Vivaldi Sync encrypts synced data end to end. The page says the browser can be personalized in layout, shortcuts, and themes.
notable: Built-in email, calendar, feed reader, and notes
Tab stacking, tab tiling, and workspaces for tab management
Mouse gestures and command chains for custom workflows
caveats: The page asks for donations to support development
Proton VPN integration is presented as a built-in feature; its terms are not described on this page
